name: ssh-mcp
description: SSH MCP server: execute commands, transfer files, and forward ports on remote servers via MCP.
long_description: ssh-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that gives AI assistants secure, scoped access to remote machines over SSH. It exposes tools for command execution, SFTP file upload/download and directory sync, remote listing, server status collection, and SSH port forwarding. Servers are configured per connection with allow-lists for commands and local/remote paths, plus optional proxy and keyboard-interactive (2FA) support.

tools.name: execute-command
tools.description: Execute a command on a remote server via SSH. Returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and duration.

tools.name: upload
tools.description: Upload a local file to a remote server via SFTP. Validates local and remote paths against configured allowed paths.

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download a remote file to the local machine via SFTP. Downloads to a temp file first, then atomically renames. Validates paths.

tools.name: list-servers
tools.description: List all configured SSH servers with their connection status.

tools.name: server-status
tools.description: Collect system status (hostname, OS, CPU, memory, disk, GPUs, processes, services) from a remote server via a single batched SSH command.

tools.name: list-remote
tools.description: List the contents of a remote directory via SFTP. Returns structured file entries with name, size, mode, modTime, and isDir.

tools.name: dir-sync
tools.description: Recursively sync a directory between local and remote via SFTP. Supports upload and download directions with concurrent file transfers.

tools.name: port-forward
tools.description: Manage SSH port forwards (local or remote). Supports open, close, and list actions.

host.title: SSH Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote SSH server.

password.title: Password
password.description: SSH password. Stored securely and passed via the SSH_MCP_PASSWORD environment variable. Provide a password, a private key, or an agent.

private_key.title: Private Key File
private_key.description: Path to an SSH private key file. Provide a private key, a password, or an agent.

passphrase.title: Private Key Passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase for the private key, if it is encrypted. Stored securely and passed via the SSH_MCP_PASSPHRASE environment variable.

agent.title: SSH Agent
agent.description: Use 'env' to use $SSH_AUTH_SOCK, or provide an explicit agent socket path. Provide an agent, a password, or a private key.

try_keyboard.title: Keyboard-Interactive Auth (2FA)
try_keyboard.description: Enable keyboard-interactive authentication, e.g. for 2FA/MFA prompts.
